# Atelier Sans Titre

> Scenography and event production studio in Beirut, Lebanon, working across the Arab world: Dubai, Riyadh, Doha, Kuwait, Amman, Cairo and beyond. Founded in 2026 by Marc Azzi, architect and scenographer. Event design for weddings, special events, brand experiences and fashion shows, for luxury clients. A scenography studio, not an event agency: we design the space an event happens in, then build it.

## What we do
- Special events: gala dinners, private dinners, private celebrations, vernissages and cultural events
- Brand experiences: product launches, brand activations, pop-ups and retail installations, press days, immersive installations
- Fashion shows: runway shows, couture shows, presentations, showrooms

Method: Concept, Design, Build. One studio accountable for the whole space, from spatial concept and set design through fabrication, lighting, technical direction and show calling.

## Sectors
Fashion, jewellery, beauty, spirits, automotive, culture and arts.

## Where
Based in Beirut, Lebanon. Serving Lebanon, the United Arab Emirates (Dubai, Abu Dhabi), Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah), Qatar (Doha), Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, Jordan (Amman), Egypt (Cairo) and the wider Arab world. Travel and international production are part of how we work.
